items.excerpt: HMD's new retro Nokia feature phones (200/210/215/235 4G) add a dedicated AI button on the D-pad that summons an on-device Sikey AI assistant for voice queries, alarms, reminders and camera control — free for 180 days, then a small annual fee.

Leaked images of Insta360's upcoming X6 show a more compact, GoPro-like action cam with 8K 360-degree capture and the company's AI subject tracking and reframing, expected to start around $800 as GoPro struggles.

Microsoft's experimental Intelligent Terminal for Windows isn't locked to Copilot — the writer got it running a local LLM in five minutes, and it also supports Claude Code, OpenAI Codex and Gemini agents, pointing at agentic, on-device AI on the desktop.

DJI's dual-camera Osmo Pocket 4P gimbal pairs a 1-inch main sensor with a 3x telephoto, a 1,000-nit OLED and 17 stops of dynamic range, leaning on its motorized gimbal and AI ActiveTrack subject tracking for hands-free creator video.

OpenAI is teasing a Codex-branded hardware collaboration — a physical accessory that maps common Codex coding-agent shortcuts to dedicated buttons, an early sign of OpenAI pushing its AI beyond the screen into purpose-built devices.

OpenAI teamed with Work Louder on a Codex-branded macro pad — an illuminated hardware device that turns Codex AI-agent commands into physical button presses, OpenAI's first tangible dev-focused gadget.
